Hi Evelyn — thanks for sending this over and for the clear summary. Confirming receipt of the W-9 and MOA draft. To get the vendor master created and allow AP to issue a PO, we typically need the following:

Required for vendor master creation:
- Legal entity name (exact)
- Tax ID (EIN) — from W-9
- Registered address (for tax/1099 mapping)
- ACH or wire instructions (bank name, account type, routing, account no) OR note that Redwood will pay by invoice via our AP portal
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone)

PO/invoice routing guidance:
- If MOA is already signed by your side and awaiting our countersignature, AP can issue a PO contingent on our countersignature.
- If MOA needs redeployment, AP prefers a PO + countersigned MOA before first payment.

Action items for Epsilon (quick checklist you can forward to procurement):
1) Confirm EIN exactly as it appears on W-9
2) Provide banking details (or confirm invoice-only payment)
3) Confirm billing contact for invoice delivery (email + preferred file format)
4) Indicate whether MOA has been executed by an authorized signer on your side

Kimberly — tagging you for the payment path and whether the PO can be generated pending our countersignature. Marissa — can you advise the internal form we need filled to capture the bank details and beneficial owner questions?

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Partnerships
